description: Rename one sender (From) or reply-to profile in place, without changing which profile is the account default. Use this to standardize a display name across the several identities a mailbox may carry, e.g. renaming 'Viraj from SnapCount' to 'SnapCount'. Get IDs from list_sender_profiles. Only the display name changes: the address, its sending domain, and the account-wide default From/Reply-To selection are untouched, and existing campaigns and sequences pinned to this profile pick up the new name. To change which profile is the default instead, use update_company with senderProfileId/replyProfileId. A company cannot have two sender identities with the same name on one address, so a colliding rename is rejected and reports the ID already using that name. Requires the companies:manage scope.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name.description: New display name, e.g. 'SnapCount'. Trimmed; must be non-empty and 255 characters or fewer.

profileId.description: ID of the profile to rename, from list_sender_profiles. Sender profile IDs come from senderProfiles, reply-to IDs from replyProfiles.

type.description: Which list profileId came from. Defaults to sender. Pass reply to rename a reply-to profile.

name: update_sender_profile

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `update_sender_profile` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

renamed.description: False when the profile already carried that name, so nothing changed.

replyProfile.description: The renamed reply-to profile, present when type was reply record returned by Sequenzy.

senderProfile.description: The renamed sender (From) profile, present when type was sender record returned by Sequenzy.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
